item.title: Andrew Scotchie & Friends — Mon Oct 26, 6:00 PM — French Broad River Brewery
item.description: We’re SO excited to have Andrew Scotchie performing in the brewery again! It’s seriously awesome to b able to host this friend and local legend! Join singer-songwriter Andrew Scotchie as he brings in a singer-songwriter showcase on one Monday every month. Born and raised in Asheville, Andrew Scotchie is everything rock-n-roll was meant to be: sweaty, soul-stirring, a little dangerous, and absolutely alive. With the fire of the Stones, the blues of Lightnin’ Hopkins, and the message of a punk-fueled preacher, Scotchie and his all-star band have become a staple of the Southeast music scene . He’s shared stages with legends, crowd-surfed dive bars, and continues to craft his unique sound. His latest record, Love Is Enough, is a love letter to connection, chaos, and keeping your heart open in a world gone sideways. ​ Through consistent heartfelt releases, year round touring and active charity work, Asheville N.C. native Andrew Scotchie is a celebrated creative force. Rocky Fork State Park To Shelton Graves on the AT, 11.5 miles, Fitness Hike — Wed Oct 28, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group Halloween hike to the Shelton Graves.
**Description:** This Out and Back hike begins at the Flint Creek Trail to the Appalachian Trail (AT). The hike begins with a flat to mild grade alongside the Flint Creek gorge progressing to an extended STEEP climb to the AT North (right turn on the AT), and continues the climb along a ridgeline to the Historic Civil War Shelton gravesite (short spur) where we will break for a snack and then return taking a partial loop on the Block Stand trail back to the flint creek trail and parking area. (After the hike, masochists may climb the spur trail up the Whitehouse Cliffs, for an additional couple of miles roundtrip.)
Elevation Gain estimated at about 2,500".
Distance: 11-11.5 miles.
**PACE:** This is a BRISK PACE Fitness Hike average pace approaching 3 MPH with brief regrouping as needed. Please know your hiking abilities before signing on. If you are new to our fitness hikes feel free to post on this site or message me

item.description:
Awakening Asheville ## **Spirited Improv Performance: "TRANSFORMANCE"**
##### We invite you into our interactive audience for a performance that transforms--a "Transformance."
**What to Expect:** Join us for an improvisational showcase of our transformational playspace. All audience members are asked to bring their full presence and be open to receive from the collective experience. You choose whether you want to stay in your seat and witness the magic or step into improvisational play in front of a supportive audience. Either way, you'll be part of the joy, the courage, and the beauty of human connection.
**All Are Welcome:** No prior experience needed, just a willingness to be in your heart. Show up exactly as you are…and discover what becomes possible in a radically accepting playspace centered in Love.
**Tickets:** Sliding Scale: $10-$50 / Person.
No tickets sold at the door.
Source: Awakening Asheville

item.title: Pressley Laton - Showroom — Thu Oct 29, 7:00 PM — Fitz and The Wolfe
Folk Art Ctr. to Visitor Ctr. and Back, 5.5 mi. 700 ft. Elev. Gain — Fri Oct 30, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **[Signup opens Sunday, Oct 25th, 8:00 PM]**
(Sorry for the late notice. Busy weekend!)
These days, the popular Mountain-to-Sea Trail between the Folk Art Center and the Blue Ridge Parkway Visitors Center has been cleared of the hurricane damage seen in the photo. It's once again a lovely and relatively mild hike. There are ups and downs--not easy if you're a new hiker--but a difficulty level of about 3 out of 10 on my highly subjective scale.
We'll make a quick stop along the route to visit a couple of very nice horses who would GREATLY appreciate it if you bring them some carrots and apple slices.
Since the BRP Visitor Center is the halfway point, we'll pause there for a 15-minute break before turning back. The VC has restrooms.
Dogs are welcome, but they must be leashed in accordance with Forest Service regulations.
**MEETING TIME & DIRECTIONS**
We'll meet at the Folk Art Center parking lot by 9:00 a.m. The entrance is well-marked near Milepost 383

Butter Gap Loop; a Saunter — Tue Nov 3, 10:00 AM
item.description: Hendo Fun Friends We will begin behind the fish hatchery up the Cedar Rock Tr (CW), visit only 1 Cedar Rock Falls side trails, visit the abandoned beaver dam pond, connect with the Butter Gap and return downhill on the (newly developed mountain bike friendly) Buttergap switchbacks. Heavily forested ‘natural' surface with occasional rock & roots. Up to 12 ppl are welcome to join us. Remember - hikes led by ‘the Curmudgeon’ tend to have pleasant surprises. Difficulty: All the climb is in the 1st half of the loop. Bridges cross the streams. The downhill from the high point is constant. **Popular mountain biker section.** **Geriatrics are asked to bring their own BP cuffs.** We are the **Sloth Hike Team of WNC**: “We will get there when we get there.” We dare to go where the ‘real’ hike groups don’t ***!!*** ***https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bf5TgVRGND4*** Hike Details: **Social ‘hour’ at 10 AM.
